items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 53:1
items.html: There are three phases of NHY of the Rosh: first, the NHY of the Rosh of the Partzuf itself; second, the NHY of the Rosh that are revealed in it through the raising of MAN by the one below it; third, the NHY of the Rosh that are revealed in it through the raising of MAN by the son of the one below it. (ibid., s.v. "and you shall know")
